title: ggml-org/llama.cpp b12788: tests : add RPC support to test-llama-archs (#33112)
author: rgerganov
snippet: Running test-llama-archs with an RPC device is quite useful as an integration test for the RPC backend. Here is a sample run with the Vulkan backend: ggml-rpc-server -d Vulkan1 test-llama-archs --rpc 127.0.0.1:50052 -b RPC0
